import json,subprocess,hashlib,re;from pathlib import Path
folder=Path(".cache/phase3");state={}
for service in ("postgres","redis","minio"):
 state[service]=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker","inspect","--format","{\"id\":{{json .Id}},\"mounts\":{{json .Mounts}}}","ai-trading-research-"+service+"-1"],text=True))
tables=subprocess.check_output(["docker","compose","exec","-T","postgres","psql","-U","research","-d","research","-Atqc","SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname=\x27public\x27 ORDER BY tablename"],text=True).splitlines()
records={}
for table in tables:
 if table=="alembic_version":continue
 assert re.fullmatch("[a-z_0-9]+",table)
 query="SELECT count(*),md5(COALESCE(string_agg(row_to_json(t)::text,\x27,\x27 ORDER BY row_to_json(t)::text),\x27\x27)) FROM "+table+" t"
 records[table]=subprocess.check_output(["docker","compose","exec","-T","postgres","psql","-U","research","-d","research","-Atqc",query],text=True).strip()
(folder/"development-before.json").write_text(json.dumps({"containers":state,"records":records},indent=2))
p=folder/"pre-migration.dump";p.touch(mode=0o600)
with p.open("wb") as out:subprocess.run(["docker","compose","exec","-T","postgres","pg_dump","-U","research","-d","research","-Fc"],stdout=out,check=True)
p.chmod(0o600)
print("PASSED: private pre-migration backup",p.stat().st_size,"bytes; SHA256",hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"; legacy table fingerprints",len(records),"; data-container IDs/mounts recorded. No data changed.")
